messages:
Maria: Hey team — running a POC with a EU-based fintech. They require all customer data (requests + logs) to remain in the EU and want no sub-processors outside EU. They also asked: can we pin inference + storage to eu-west-1, provide an egress whitelist, and what the pricing uplift looks like for a short Dedicated commit? Also need canned answers for their security questionnaire.
Jake: Quick clarification — do they mean only inference + logs, or also metadata/control-plane (billing, usage analytics)?
Maria: Only inference + logs. They said they can tolerate control plane metadata staying in our control plane outside EU as long as customer data is never exported.
Sanjay: High level: we can keep inference and S3 storage in EU for POC. Sub-processors that touch data: AWS (eu-west-1) for compute + S3, Fastly for CDN if we enable streaming (can be restricted), and our observability pipeline (we can opt-out of shipping raw logs off-region). Need legal signoff for any named subproc contract clauses.
Olivia: For Dedicated short POC: we can provision a dedicated GPU pool in eu-west-1 and scope logs to an EU-only S3 bucket. Note: our default control plane still talks to the management plane in our region unless they choose Private (VPC) deployment — Private gives full control of control plane location. For routing/pinning we support a per-tenant routing policy. Example config we can provide to ops:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acct-12345",
  "preferred_region": "eu-west-1",
  "egress_whitelist": ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.0/24"],
  "allow_subprocessors": ["AWS-eu-west-1"],
  "control_plane_exposed": false
}
```
Jake: I can turn that into a short one-pager and a security-questionnaire template. Important note for the SQA: call out that keys can be BYOK with EU KMS, and that we support customer-managed S3 encryption.
Ricardo: Pricing notes: short Dedicated (1 month POC) — rough uplift 15–30% on top of hosted per-token for reserved capacity + baseline GPU reservation. If they want strict EU-only control plane (Private), add base platform fee + infra support (it varies a lot by commit, but single-digit k$/month floor for small POCs). I'll give a back-of-envelope in the doc.
Sanjay: Security snippets to include in the SQA template:
- Data residency statement: "Customer request and response payloads and persisted logs for tenant X will be stored and processed in AWS eu-west-1. No data will be exported off EU without explicit consent."
- Sub-processor list: "AWS (eu-west-1), our EU S3 storage, optional CDN provider (Fastly EU POPs) — contact legal for current certs and DPA."
Jake: I'll prepare two assets: 1) short technical routing playbook (how we pin + egress whitelist + sample config), 2) security questionnaire stub with the above language and KMS/BYOK options. Can we get legal to review the sub-processor wording before I send? @Sanjay can you queue legal?
Sanjay: Will do. Looping legal in separately.
Maria: Awesome — can we aim to have the draft assets and the pricing ballpark by EOD tomorrow? Customer wants them for their compliance call on Friday.
Olivia: We can spin a Dedicated test pool in ~48 hours if commit signed; otherwise, we can do a light demo using hosted with eu region data path and strict retention settings in ~24 hours (but call out that hosted control-plane is outside EU).
Maria: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll flag the customer that we'll deliver the routing playbook + SQA draft + price ballpark tomorrow. :thumbsup:
routebot: Reminder: POC billing alert will be created when a Dedicated commit > $5k is entered.
Maria: Noted — will coordinate procurement.
